items.title: Skitch Henderson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Milford, Connecticut, October 31, 1998
items.q: Zeke Zarchy, oh, wonderful, wonderful players, friends of mine, were all in that.

ctx.x: I recently conducted the New Haven Symphony in Woolsey Hall, and that was where that orchestra was born, the military orchestra. When he broke up his dance band, New Haven was the headquarters. That’s where they brought all of these musicians. Isn’t that wonderful? Ray McKinley, everybody, all of them came there. Zeke Zarchy, oh, wonderful, wonderful players, friends of mine, were all in that. I thought of conducting that orchestra on this stage, and I looked at those long hairs in the symphony and I tried to say…
